529-5295-7690-8181--165.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, causing you to surveil 1.
Denzilore triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2292-2577-6664-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2292-2577-6664-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

643-4247-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
643-4247-4302.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Maskwood Nexus, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

728-2178-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
728-2178-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

222-527-1322-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1322-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

5200-7908.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Halflings.
5200-7908.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

2060-3574-4222-7741.notablePrerequisites: Mikaeus does not have summoning sickness.
2060-3574-4222-7741.description:
Activate Mikaeus' second ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Activate Mikaeus' first ability by tapping it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Mikaeus.
Repeat.
2060-3574-4222-7741.notes: If Mikaeus has a +1/+1 counter on it, you may skip steps 4 and 5 during that iteration.

2173-4496-5220-5931.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
When Accursed Centaur enters, it triggers, sacrificing itself.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Funeral Room trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2438-3605-4812-5987.description:
Cast Animate Dead by paying {1}{B}.
When Animate Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Animate Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Dance of the Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Dance of the Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dance of the Dead enters, it trigger, returning Angel of Indemnity from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Dance of the Dead to it.
When Angel of Indemnity enters, it triggers, targeting Animate Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Angel of Indemnity.
Resolve the Angel of Indemnity trigger, returning Animate Dead from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

360-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2438-5617.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fungal Fortitude triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fungal Fortitude from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-3259-4742.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-3259-4742.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1438-4410.easyPrerequisites:
Hermetic Study attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
1438-4410.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
1438-4410.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

539-2921-7031.description:
Cast Badgermole by paying its mana cost
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Badgermole
When Badgermole dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Badgermole enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-4067-6281-6927.description:
Activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Damage Control Crew.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Damage Control Crew that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Damage Control Crew token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Damage Control Crew from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon.
Repeat.

3230-3678-6879.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
3230-3678-6879.description:
Play Coral Atoll.
When Coral Atoll enters, it and Retreat to Emeria trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a 1/1 Kor Ally creature token.
When the Kor Ally enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Coral Atoll.
Resolve the Coral Atoll trigger from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it
Haru triggers, returning Coral Atoll from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

4484-5686-6440.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich died this turn.
4484-5686-6440.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ebondeath.
Repeat.

575-4121-4677-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-4121-4677-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Birchlore Rangers.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Zendikar's Roil triggers, creating a 2/2 Elemental creature token.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers' morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

2178-2263-4050-4536-5111.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goldberry.
Goldberry does not have summoning sickness.
Goldberry and Geralf's Mindcrusher do not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
2178-2263-4050-4536-5111.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Mindcrusher, adding {U}.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher dies, its undying ability and Goldberry trigger twice.
Resolve the first Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Geralf's Mindcrusher enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing a player to mill five cards.
Resolve the second Geralf's Mindcrusher trigger, doing nothing.
Resolve the first Goldberry trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Goldberry's first ability by tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Geralf's Mindcrusher onto Goldberry.
Resolve the second Goldberry trigger from step 2, untapping it.
Activate Goldberry's second ability by paying {U} and tapping it, moving the +1/+1 counter from Goldberry onto Drivnod, and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Cavalier of Night

624-5011-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Phantasmal Image.
When Phantasmal Image dies, its last ability from Cavalier of Night triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When Phantasmal Image enters the battlefield, its first triggered ability from Cavalier of Night triggers; choose not to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1.
Repeat.

371-3499-5003.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Forests.
371-3499-5003.description:
Activate five Forests by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Llanowar Druid by tapping and sacrificing it.
Llanowar Druid dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Llanowar Druid from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Llanowar Druid ability from step 2, untapping all Forests.
Repeat.

2645-2800-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2645-2800-4657.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {10}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.
